# SocialProofCarousel

Full-bleed slider of QuoteCards: the active slide centered with equal peeks of its neighbours, knockout IconButton arrows, native toggle-button pagination. No autoplay.

## Decisions

- ⏳ **open** `spc-nav-component` (Matt): The section frame carries both a 'Global / Carousel' nav instance and an 'IconButton — v2'. Which is the arrow control of record? → Code uses IconButton — v2 (knockout, lg), matching the icon-button bindings on the section (icon-button/background/knockout/default, content/knockout). Confirm and remove the Global / Carousel instances from the frame. _Evidence: get_metadata 12102:175374; get_variable_defs binds s2a/color/icon-button/* knockout._
- ✅ decided `spc-dot-tokens` (Claude): Pagination dots used raw white at 40% and pure white with nothing bound in the section frame. → Bound to the tokens the .QuoteCard DotPagination instance binds: inactive transparent/white/64, active content/knockout, radius/round, size spacing/xs. Applied in social-proof-carousel.css 2026-09-17. _Evidence: quote-card.figma.evidence.json .pagination/.dot-* bindings._
- ✅ decided `spc-nav-inset` (Claude): Arrow inset is 40px on desktop; spacing/2xl is 40px. Bind it? → Bind to {s2a.spacing.2xl} in the spec transform; the value matches and the Figma inset is 40. _Evidence: Figma Nav items x=40 / 512+40; social-proof-carousel.css lines 38–39._
- ✅ decided `spc-peek-geometry` (Claude): Peek fractions and gaps per breakpoint. → 1920: 220px (11.46%), 1440: 124px (8.6%), 375: 16px; 8px gaps; active slide at peek + gap so both neighbours peek equally. _Evidence: Figma 12102:175386 Active Slide x=220; 8278:190566 Active Slide x=24 w=327; e2e + visual eval 2026-09-15._
- ✅ decided `spc-autoplay` (Claude): Does the carousel autoplay? → No. Arrow keys, arrows and dots only; transition 500ms on the shared curve, off under reduced motion. _Evidence: spec a11y notes; motion eval contracts._

## Accessibility

WCAG 2.2 AA: `2.1.1`, `2.2.2`, `2.4.7`

- `ArrowLeft`: Previous slide except inside editable fields
- `ArrowRight`: Next slide except inside editable fields
- `Tab`: Move through enabled native controls and the active slide's CTA
- No autoplay. Transform transition is 500 ms and disabled by prefers-reduced-motion.
- Inactive slides are inert and aria-hidden; pagination uses native toggle buttons, not incomplete tabs.
- Call destroy() before replacing the DOM; it aborts event listeners and disconnects the ResizeObserver.

- `organisms-socialproofcarousel--default` Default

- `organisms-socialproofcarousel--two-slides` Two slides
